title: Absorption and hepatic uptake of dietary cholesterol
compartment: Intestinal lumen and enterocyte, then lymph, plasma and hepatocyte

steps.note: Apical membrane; the ABCG5-ABCG8 pump returns part of it to the lumen
Endoplasmic reticulum; expressed in enterocytes and hepatocytes
Assembly with apoB-48 requires MTTP; chylomicrons are secreted into lymph
Bound to GPIHBP1 on capillary endothelium; hydrolyses triacylglycerol
APOE binds LDLR and LRP1; lysosomal acid lipase (LIPA) frees cholesterol
